title: New Hoffman–Levin collaboration on recursive trace logic

tellings.quote: Actually we're just now starting up a collaboration. we're going to get a postto together because of the trace logic um this recursive trace logic

plain: The cognitive scientist Donald Hoffman says he and the biologist Mike Levin are just starting to work together in 2026. Their shared interest is a piece of mathematics Hoffman calls "recursive trace logic", and they plan to hire a junior researcher to work on it. Hoffman tells it as his own news, and it matters to him because it would join his theories of the mind with Levin's work in biology.
